prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the bustling atmosphere of an airport gate. On the far left, a man in a red scarf stands holding a black suitcase, his posture rigid and impatient. Next to him sits a woman in a blue coat on a metal bench, her head tilted back in exhaustion. A brown dog rests its chin on her knee, looking up at her with soft eyes. In the center foreground, a child in a yellow raincoat points excitedly at a large window, while a father in a grey suit looks down at the boy with a gentle smile. Behind them, a flight attendant in a navy uniform checks a clipboard, standing tall and professional. To her right, an elderly man in a tweed cap leans heavily on a wooden cane, watching the tarmac. A green backpack lies abandoned on the floor next to the cane, slightly crushed under its weight. Further back, a teenager with headphones around their neck taps rhythmically on a silver laptop, completely absorbed in the screen. Beside the teen, a barista in a white apron hands a paper cup to a businessman in a dark tie, who reaches out eagerly to take it. Near the boarding desk, a security officer in a black vest scans a passport held by a tourist in a floral dress. The tourist smiles nervously, clutching her boarding pass tightly. Above the scene, a digital departure board hangs from the ceiling, displaying blurry text. A potted fern sits in the corner, its leaves drooping slightly from neglect. There is no electronic signage with bright LED lights. There is no advertising billboard on the walls.
